# UpLevel Automations

> AI operations dashboards for cleaning companies. Built and run by Roy Banwell,
> who operates a cleaning company doing 200+ cleans a month and built these
> systems for his own business before selling them.

## What we do

Service OS connects a cleaning company's existing tools (QuickBooks or Xero,
plus a field service platform such as Housecall Pro, Jobber, ServiceTitan, or
BookingKoala) into one live view of job profitability, crew performance, and
cash position. $2,500 build, $500/mo. Roughly 2 weeks to deliver.
